Who we are
Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.
As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

At Moniepoint, product management blends entrepreneurial drive, deep customer insight, and modern technology to solve the toughest problems in the service of powering the financial ambitions of millions across Africa.
Over the years, our product craft - the operating system for how products are envisioned, built, launched, and run - has been shaped and refined by the core practices of leading tech companies, while staying true to the unique DNA that has made Moniepoint one of Africa’s fastest-growing companies.
At the core of this craft are our Product Managers: outcome-driven builders who live and breathe the realities, challenges, and dreams of our customers. They thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and partner deeply with engineering, design, and cross-functional teams to build products grounded in simplicity, trust, and delight from day one. They challenge the status quo - wherever it originates - and hold a high bar for product quality and execution excellence, starting with themselves.

Own and drive outcomes anchored in metrics and aligned with company OKRs.
Know your domain in depth: business, product, operations, customers, market, competitors, and risk/regulation.
Maintain a roadmap that balances near- and long-term priorities, and the right mix of growth levers, technical investments, and risk/regulatory requirements.
Leverage ongoing customer discovery, product analytics, and a range of experimentation techniques to validate assumptions and refine product direction and priorities.
Break down ambiguous, complex problems into clear proposals, actionable plans, and structured tradeoff scenarios and recommendations.
Pairs business acumen with a strong product, design, and technical mindset - ideally with true fluency in technical concepts, even without an engineering degree.
Dive beyond dashboards and interrogate the data directly. Build your own queries and analyses to validate hypotheses, stress-test intuition, and monitor early product signals.
Own the product’s written backbone: from one-pagers and PRDs to GTM plans, release scopes, and user stories.
Cultivate relationships with customers, teams, stakeholders, and leaders to ensure product direction is clearly communicated, aligned, and grounded in real-world context.
Hold a high bar for ownership, decision-making rigor, product quality, and execution excellence across teams and key partners.
What you need to succeed
Bachelor’s degree (strong preference for candidates with degrees in a technical field)
8+ years of relevant experience in technology companies, including 5+ years owning and driving products end-to-end as a Product Manager.
Track record of driving measurable outcomes tied to OKRs, shaping product direction, and converting complexity and ambiguity into high-value opportunities.
Deep customer empathy and the ability to synthesize qualitative and quantitative insights to build products that truly delight users.
Known for driving product velocity while upholding high standards of execution excellence, product quality, and risk mitigation.
Strong analytical skills across metric design and monitoring, funnel analysis, and evidence-based prioritization. Hands-on SQL experience is highly desirable.
Technical fluency to dive deep into system architecture, APIs, data flows, and tradeoff discussions with engineers.
Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, especially in executive-level and cross-functional settings.
High autonomy, sound judgment, resilience, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment.
What sets you apart
Domain experience (where applicable- to be advised on a case-by-case basis).
Experience building, launching, and scaling fintech products.
Experience building products from zero-to-one or shaping entirely new product lines.

Culture - We put our people first and prioritise the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information.

We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.
In the AI era, users expect Search to effortlessly Answer, Explore, and Address Anything. To meet these rising expectations, our models need the content.
The Search Content Platform (SCP) team builds an AI-first content platform to deliver a comprehensive and trustworthy knowledge source. By acquiring third-party data and organizing disparate modalities-such as text, images, videos, and User-Generated Content-into a seamless whole, we make Search AI experiences rich, helpful, and performant.
Our team's mission is to use AI to revolutionize how we acquire and organize third-party content. As the Group Product Manager for Content Acquisition and Identity, you will manage a team to define the future of Google Search content. You will collaborate with engineering teams in Zurich, Sao Paulo, and Mountain View, and represent the organization to key partners.
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information - any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

* Lead the product goal, detailed platform requirements for a horizontal content acquisition platform that accelerates third-party (3P) content acquisition while delivering on critical priority verticals such as Sports and Health.
* Enable Search to answer billions of user queries daily by innovating on content identity for the AI era and establishing clear, disambiguated, and precise identities for billions of user queries on Search daily.
* Direct efforts to analyze billions of current and aspirational user queries that lack sufficient content, and prioritize or drive initiatives to bridge these gaps and improve product helpfulness to end users.
* Discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process to demonstrate the AI fluency expected in this role.

Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.
We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds.

We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models.

The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world.

A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.
As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.

Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.

A track record of solving hard problems.
Proven experience building, shipping, or supporting generative media products — video, image, or world models — or real-time rendering and graphics technology at scale.
Experience productizing research: turning model capabilities into product and product signal back into research priorities, with fluency in the tradeoffs that define this space — quality, latency, inference cost, and compute.
A deep understanding of the product life cycle and a history of collaborating with engineering teams and other stakeholders to deliver complex technical products on time.
Experience shipping to large consumer or creator communities, ideally in gaming, UGC platforms, or creative tools.
A Masters degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Graphics, 3D Animation, or Games Production, or a similar technical field.
Passion for driving user-centric product decisions with an inclusive and strategic mindset, comfort in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment, and a high degree of independent drive.

Strong business analysis skills with the ability to gather, document, and translate complex business requirements into actionable product solutions.
Experience working closely with cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Design, Operations, and business stakeholders.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build relationships across all levels of the organisation.
Self-starter with strong initiative, able to operate effectively in a fast-paced and evolving environment.​‌
You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banks in the world, on projects that will transform the financial services industry.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.
Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.
Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.
Senior Product Manager, AI CI/CD

Chainguard secures the software supply chain, and we're standing up a new team to build a new product inside it.
Agents now write a large and growing share of the world's code, and they inherited a CI system designed for humans who push a few times a day. Write, push, wait in a queue, reinstall the same toolchain, scrape the logs, try again.

Agents iterate far more often than people do, so they feel every minute of that, and the workarounds they've grown are worse than the thing they're working around. We don't think the fix is a faster version of the CI you already have. We think CI gets rebuilt for agents, and that's what we're doing.
The product isn't launched, so a job post is the wrong place for the details. What we can tell you now: the team is small, the hard technical pieces already run in production inside Chainguard, and you'd be driving the product direction.

Strategy and roadmap. Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the product. Decide what we build first, what comes next, and what we're not going to do.
0→1 product work. Take this from a system that works for us to a product customers buy and use. Bring structure to problems that don't have any yet, make the tradeoff calls, and get things in front of users before they feel finished.
How agents actually build software. Go deep on how developers and their agents write, test, review, and ship code today, including the parts nobody blogs about. Most of what's written about agentic development is aspirational. You'll work from what people really do.
Design partners. Find the teams whose agent fleets are big enough to hurt, get the product into their hands early, and turn what they tell you into priorities.
Developer experience. Adoption is the whole game here. Own how the product gets tried, configured, and lived with, so a team can move onto it without running a migration project.
Launch. Positioning, naming, docs, the pricing model, and the story, with Product Marketing and the rest of Product. You're also the person who says when it's ready.
Cross-functional leadership. Partner with Engineering, Experience, Product Marketing, and other Product leaders, and keep a small team pointed at the same thing while the space shifts underneath it.

5+ years of product management experience on developer-facing, infrastructure, security, or similarly technical products.
You've built agent tools. Something agents use, or something people use to build with agents: a coding agent, an agent framework or harness, MCP servers, eval systems, or developer tooling meant to be driven by a model instead of a person. This is the requirement that matters most to us.
You know CI from the inside. Builds, tests, caches, runners, artifacts, merge gates, and the specific reasons pipelines end up slow, flaky, and expensive. You should have opinions about why.
You don't need to be a GitHub Actions expert. We're not building a better Actions, and years of workflow YAML isn't the experience we're hiring for. Knowing where it breaks is.
Experience taking a technical product from an early idea through launch and iteration.
Judgment about what to leave out. A new product dies from doing too much as easily as from doing too little.
Comfort with a deeply technical engineering team. You can hold your own in a design discussion and disagree with an engineer about a tradeoff.
You talk to developers directly and often, and you can tell the difference between technology people find interesting and a product they'll actually adopt.
You write well. We make decisions in documents here.
You can operate on your own in a fast-moving area with no established playbook.

You've run coding agents in production at real volume, or built the systems that keep them from breaking things.
Experience with developer platforms, build systems, remote execution, or hosted development environments.
Experience with containers, Kubernetes, registries, or other cloud-native infrastructure.
You've built security products for developers, and you know how fast a developer abandons one that gets in the way.
Experience with products that serve individual developers and large enterprises at the same time.
You've owned your own team's CI at some point and hated it.

The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries.

The New York Times is looking for a Product Manager to join our News Product mission. This team works with our newsroom to innovate across storytelling formats, surfaces and experiences and the tools that power them.
As a Product Manager, you'll support product development across a range of editorially grounded initiatives . You'll partner with editors, designers, engineers, and analysts to evolve how we inform and engage our readers. You will have a specific focus on growing weekly usage of our comment section.

Define a roadmap by gathering requirements, authoring tickets, organizing the product backlog, communicating with partners, and assessing bugs and feedback

Lead team ceremonies (stand-ups, planning, retros) and promoting a collaborative, inclusive, and mission-driven team culture
Develop collaborative relationships with partners in Engineering, Design, Data, Project Management, Audience Insights, and the Newsroom

Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Experience working in ambiguous, cross-functional problem spaces with multiple stakeholders

Experience growing an online community in a professional or personal capacity

Natera is at the forefront of personalized genetic testing, transforming the management of disease worldwide. As we scale our life-saving diagnostics, we are fundamentally transforming how software products are conceived, built, and delivered across our clinical and genomic portfolio.
We are seeking an experienced Principal Digital Product Manager to join our Oncology Comprehensive Genomic Profiling (CGP) Product Engineering team. In this senior individual contributor role, you will serve as the product lead for our most complex platform initiatives — owning end-to-end product strategy and execution across a sophisticated system of interconnected software products.
You will act as the product backbone for our most critical "Pillar" projects.

Success in this role demands mastery from three dimensions: partnership with commercial teams to define product strategy/roadmap based on market needs; deep fluency in how end users - lab operations, clinical teams, customer success teams - actually work; and close collaboration with Engineering, R&D, and PMO on product design and delivery.

You will synthesize all three into product decisions that hold up end-to-end — from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting — ultimately delivering reliable, high-quality solutions that patient care depends on.
Crucially, while this is an individual contributor role, you will operate as a central leader — driving consensus, roadmap alignment, and product excellence through influence rather than formal authority across Engineering, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams. You thrive in fluid environments, adapt quickly to change, and chart a clear path forward even amid unknowns.

Strategic Leadership & Vision

· Define Long-Term Vision: Develop and execute multi-year software product roadmaps for critical business units, balancing rapid prototyping with long-term commercial stability.

· Architect Complex Solutions: Act as a high-level Architect, translating broad business goals into detailed functional workflows. You are accountable for the cohesion and integrity of the final end-to-end solution.

· Founder's Mindset: Champion a culture of high agency and urgency, making quick, data-driven decisions in ambiguous situations to deliver critical milestones in a fast-paced environment.

· Cross-Functional Influence: Lead by expertise rather than authority, aligning stakeholders across R&D, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Regulatory to ensure the software roadmap meets broader business goals.
Product Excellence & Execution

· End-to-End Ownership: Lead the full product lifecycle for complex software solutions, ensuring a seamless user journey across various system boundaries — from order ingestion through lab execution to patient reporting.

· Technical Translation: Serve as the primary domain expert, translating complex scientific, clinical, or technical requirements into robust, scalable software specifications.

· Operational Immersion: Passionately advocate for internal and external users by regularly shadowing operations and engaging with customers to ensure software solves real-world physical and clinical problems.

· Systems Thinking: Maintain a "big picture" view of how software systems interact across the entire data lifecycle, understanding how upstream decisions ripple through to downstream clinical and reporting outcomes.

· Agile Mastery: Lead with the rigor of a seasoned project manager, owning product backlogs and driving Agile ceremonies to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features.

· AI-Native Product Development: Pioneer the use of LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate product discovery, automate requirements synthesis, and continuously improve how we deliver value to users.
Regulatory & Quality Leadership

· Compliance Champion: Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure all products comply with relevant global standards and certifications, including FDA design controls, IEC 62304, and HIPAA.

· Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and mitigate product risks, ensuring robust documentation and compliance without compromising development velocity.
Mentorship & Craft

· Leveling Up the Org: Mentor and guide Senior Product Managers and cross-functional team members, instilling best practices in product management, agile development, and user-centered design.

· Culture Building: Foster a product culture of accountability, technical rigor, and cross-functional collaboration across the organization.

· Experience: 10+ years of product management experience in high-scale software or biotech environments, with a proven track record of operating at a Director-level seniority.

· Zero-to-One Track Record: Demonstrated experience building and launching new software products from the ground up in a startup or internal incubator environment.

· Regulated Industry Expertise: Deep experience in highly regulated environments (e.g., FDA design controls, HIPAA, IEC 62304, or ISO standards). Exposure to HealthTech, MedTech, or genomics is highly advantageous.

· Technical Aptitude: Strong ability to understand complex technical architectures (APIs, microservices, LIMS, Data Platforms, event-driven systems) and communicate effectively with engineering and scientific teams.

· AI-Native Fluency: Hands-on experience using LLMs and generative AI tools to accelerate product workflows, requirements generation, or operational insight.

· Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas and influence executive-level stakeholders.

· Education: BS/MS in a relevant technical, scientific, or quantitative discipline; MBA or equivalent experience is a plus.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

· High Agency & Technical Initiative: You are a natural builder who thrives in fluid, fast-moving environments. Rather than waiting for requirements to be handed down, you inspect systems, audit user needs, chart a path forward amid unknowns, and drive product decisions proactively.

· Deep Systems-Level Cognition: You bring expert-level mastery of the system from two dimensions — architectural depth and functional fluency. You can trace how minor changes in upstream services impact downstream clinical reporting, catching product failure modes that only someone who truly knows the system would anticipate.

· Cross-Functional Leadership through Influence: You operate as a central leader without formal authority — driving consensus, alignment, and product excellence across Engineering, R&D, Commercial, and Clinical teams through technical credibility, communication, and emotional intelligence.

· User-Centric Validation Ethos: You understand that technically correct solutions are incomplete if the final product degrades the clinical or laboratory operational experience. You rigorously validate that software delivers on its promise for real users.

s.h: The Role - Principal Product Manager, American Football Products
s.t:
The Genius Sports Product Team is looking for an exceptional Principal Product Manager to lead our American Football product suite. As part of the Data & AI product team, you will work with the leading Football leagues and federations (e.g., NFL, NCAA, and others) to build, enhance, and maintain the products that capture, process, and deliver football data and insights to teams, leagues, media, and betting partners around the world.
You will own the full football product suite — AI-driven/automated eventing, Performance Studio enhancements, Next Generation Stats & insights, and Rich data graphics/visualizations — across the entire product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through build, launch, and ongoing growth and improvement.

This is an opportunity to shape how football data and analytics are captured and experienced across the industry defining the modern language of sport. You will be working at the intersection of computer vision, real-time data collection, and advanced sports analytics.
The ideal candidate has strong American Football domain experience and is seasoned at delivering modern, data-driven B2B SaaS products, is comfortable owning a diverse product portfolio, and can move fluidly between deep technical/data conversations and strategic, executive-level discussions. You will define and evangelize a clear product roadmap, manage cross-functional stakeholders, and drive measurable outcomes using both qualitative and quantitative data.

As the Senior Product Manager, American Football, you will be responsible for a suite of football products spanning the full data and analytics value chain:
Football Events Feeds – Real-time and post-game football events feeds used by leagues, broadcasters, and downstream partners.
Football Statistics Feeds – Core and advanced football statistics feeds that power team, player, and league-level analysis.
Performance Studio – Driving a roadmap of continual improvements to our player and team performance analytics platform, including new metrics, workflows, and user experience improvements.
Next Generation Stats & Visualizations – Development of next-generation football statistics, tracking-derived metrics, and data visualizations that differentiate Genius Sports in the market.

Build, Maintain, and Grow the Genius American Football Product Suite
Understand customer needs across leagues, teams, media, and betting partners; develop requirements and drive delivery of football events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations.
Own the product lifecycle end-to-end — from ideation, discovery, and validation through build, launch, and post-launch growth and iteration — for each product in the football portfolio.
Define and evangelize a clear, prioritized product roadmap for football products, and communicate it consistently to internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborate closely with engineering, design, data operations, and business teams to ensure football product initiatives are delivered on time and on budget.
Provide strategic direction on data-informed, long-term investment opportunities for the football portfolio, evaluating tradeoffs and prioritizing in consultation with cross-divisional partners.
Balance investment across the football product portfolio across three horizons - Now/Horizon 1 (0-12 months), Next/Horizon 2 (12-36 months), and Future/Horizon 3 (36+ months)), ensuring a healthy mix of incremental improvement and longer-term innovation.
Define KPIs that drive business results for football products, build dashboards to measure performance, and make data-driven decisions using both qualitative and quantitative analysis.
Partner with commercial, marketing, and operations teams to drive efficient, effective go-to-market motions and continuously gather feedback from leagues, teams, and media/betting partners and translate it into product requirements.
Stay current on football analytics trends, computer vision tracking technology, and competitor offerings to keep the football product suite at the forefront of the industry.

7-10 years of relevant product management experience.
Strong American Football domain knowledge/expertise
Product management experience building B2B SaaS or other relevant data feeds/ applications: understanding functional requirements and building for scale.
Strong grasp of product lifecycle mechanics: discovery, analysis, defining and driving OKRs, ideation, prioritization, and delivering measurable outcomes.
Experience owning multiple related products or a product portfolio simultaneously, balancing competing priorities across a suite of offerings.
Extensive background collaborating with UX design partners to build intuitive, user-first experiences.
Strong background in BI and/or analytics required; experience working on data-oriented or sports statistics products preferred.
Outstanding written and oral communication skills, including experience presenting to executive leadership, participating in the sales cycle, and handling sensitive, critical issues.
Experience working in and delivering products or services in an agile/lean environment, including backlog management (user stories, epics, and bugs).
Proficiency in gathering and transforming product requirements into a practical, prioritized product roadmap.
Prior experience as a football statistician, analyst, or a strong passion for football and football analytics is a plus.

American Football events feeds, statistics feeds, Performance Studio, and Next Generation stats/visualizations operate as a coherent, well-sequenced portfolio rather than disconnected efforts.
Product decisions are consistently grounded in customer needs and data to drive our Genius revenue streams, with clear KPIs tracked and acted on.
Cross-functional teams (engineering, design, data ops, commercial) trust the roadmap and rely on the PM as the source of truth for football product direction.
Leagues, teams, and media/betting partners see measurable improvement in the quality, timeliness, and depth of football data and insights.
The American Football product suite is recognized internally and externally as a differentiator for Genius Sports in the market.
The salary for this role is based on an annualized salary range of $230,000 - $270,000. This role will also be eligible to take part in Genius Sports Group's benefits plan.

As well as a competitive salary and range of benefits, we’re committed to supporting employee wellbeing and helping you grow your skills, experience and career. Learn more about how rewarding life at Genius can be at Reward | Genius Sports.

Own the Latis Data Clean Room product roadmap , vision, requirements, and priorities.

Author and maintain product, technical, build, and data onboarding documentation .

Apply experience across Snowflake, Amazon, and The Trade Desk to inform Latis architecture and support cross-platform interoperability.
Develop requirements for data-sharing architectures, including Snowflake-to-Snowflake workflows and other secure data exchange patterns.
Identify opportunities to improve the clean room experience, scalability, usability, and partner adoption.
Maintain strong awareness of the evolving data clean room ecosystem and emerging industry practices.

Hands-on product experience with data clean room technologies , particularly Snowflake, Amazon, and/or The Trade Desk.
Strong understanding of data-sharing architectures, data collaboration, identity/matching, and privacy-safe data use .
Experience defining product requirements and roadmaps for technically complex products.
Experience creating clear technical and product documentation for engineering teams and external partners.

Comfortable working closely with Data Science and Data Engineering teams.
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear requirements and business outcomes.
